info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Trust Services API
info.description: The Corporate Trust Services API allows users to modify and enhance various aspects of corporate trust management. It provides operations to manage trust accounts, streamline service requests, and update beneficiary information. This API is designed for financial institutions and corporate clients that require dynamic adjustments to their trust services. Common use cases include updating trust beneficiary details, adjusting account settings, and handling service changes efficiently.
